findings.statement: The duplicate-mount arm is real in the user's own profile: @linxin666/dsh-web-all@0.3.20 declares dsh-better-sidebar and mounts it with an UNGUARDED row web-ui-better-sidebar, so a new mpd row must back off there.

Order B (mpd installed before an aggregate) becomes a fatal duplicate mount under a naive guarded insert; the sidebar's own guard is forward-blind and documents the same limitation. Requires an order-independent guard or a blocking finding.

A runtime ctx.plugin() mount can never satisfy the requirement: the browser half is discovered from LOADER ENTRIES (dsh.client + exports['./client']), so a real row named dsh-better-sidebar is mandatory.

Tension to settle by measurement: scripts/pack-mpd.mjs#writeBundleManifest still claims a plain dependencies entry is not enough (repro evidence/plan-e/e1-team-route, whose bundleDependency step is a manifest check), while CM-3 says the harness heals the profile closure. Settle with a real install + boot.
scripts/pack-mpd.mjs writes its own manifest, so a root-only dependency declaration is lost in the packed artifact.

Composition evidence gives two evidence-backed non-web guard predicates: @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver (recommended) or entry id agent-presets; both precede the mpd band in the web dump and are absent in the TUI dump.

handoff: Deliver BOTH the manifest declaration (incl. pack-mpd.mjs) and a real loader row.
Two guards on the row: non-web plane and duplicate mount.
Proof is a mounting boot, never --dump-config; assert F1-F3 absent.
Sandbox DSH_HOME, HOME and the workspace cwd.
skills/** single-writer + single re-pin if any skill file changes.
